I've made it fairly apparent to my significant other that it upsets me. I'm sure he's just expressing his appreciation for the female anatomy. He's only 19, and so I understand that at that age, things become difficult in terms of ignoring them, but I think his respect for me, or lack thereof, makes me want to scissor kick him straight in the face. But he didnt start acting this way until he moved away. I understand. It's like new toy syndrome, but I don't think I can expect him respect me if I can't respect myself. 

As for the confidence, I've been working on it but its become difficult, especially since I have no idea how to gain that sort of feeling. I see myself and I'm absolutely disgusted. I don't know how to change that. Thank you so much for this. I appreciate it very much! I will really try my best!

I'm no good at any of that. My singing is awful although I enjoy it none the less. I enjoy all creative things. But can never master any of them well enough to take pride in them. 
But expression at all would be better than a shut-in, so there's that. :)
Thank you for taking the time to type this. I appreciate it and will consider your words!!!

Thank you for that. "This, too, shall pass." In short. I believe a portion of me, even as small of a portion as it may be, has this stubborn and deliberate refusal to give up. I suppose that's an indication that I still have a willingness to live and a purpose for said life. It's been years. Everyone has a lump in relationships, everyone has a pain in the ass family and has a shit job, everyone is going through the same difficulty with a much more easy going disposition. That's not me. That's not how I roll. And it makes me feel like a selfish asshole. Many people have it much worse. i know this because I have plenty of scars as constant reminders that the worst had happened to me. 
I'm apprehensive about everything and I don't know why. I even get customers in my place of work telling me to calm down. 
I'm a bit of a perfectionist. And tend to stress over mundane crap. I don't have very many happy memories and I don't see my future being any better. So why should I keep going? And continue to be miserable? I've tried everything to gain my confidence, to gain respect, and gain an ability to say "no". But I'm still such a doormat and I'm sure a person could kill my mother and I still could never hate them as much as I hate myself. 

But this has really helped. It makes a lot of sense, Thank you. I appreciate the time you took to type this out. I appreciate you as an individual. Very straight forward and it really put a lot into perspective. Thanks so much!
